entries.name: NASA POWER daily (regional reanalysis)
entries.question: How often did the plan's dates meet an early cold night, and what rain and temperatures did the same dates have in past years?
entries.dates: 1981-2025 bundled; recent past days fetched live
entries.scope: One regional value (grid about 55 km) for the whole area; not per field
entries.quality: Checked against NOAA GSOD Neuquén Aero: places first cold nights later than the station (reads optimistic); no bias correction applied

entries.name: NASA HLS v2.0 vegetation index (NDVI), Landsat L30 + Sentinel-2 S30
entries.question: What did the processed example parcels look like on each 2024 date?
entries.scope: Four processed example parcels (30 m pixels, 30 m inward buffer) and their cluster
entries.quality: Fmask clean-pixel rule; dates classed clear / partly masked / mostly masked

entries.name: Open-Meteo forecast (not NASA)
entries.question: What weather is expected for actions in the coming days?
entries.variables: temperature (°C), rain (mm), rain chance (%), wind (km/h); units validated or converted
entries.scope: nearest model grid point (a few km)
entries.quality: weather-model estimate; not an official warning

entries.name: NOAA GSOD, Neuquén Aero station 87715099999
entries.question: Does the regional POWER record place cold nights like a nearby station?
entries.scope: one station about 45 km away; not a validation at the plot
entries.quality: different hours (UTC vs local) and siting

entries.name: HLS S30 red edge (NDRE, exploratory)
entries.status: probed: subset produced, not used in the suggestion
entries.question: Does a red-edge signal add anything to NDVI for the examples?
entries.dates: 48 Sentinel-2 dates in 2024 (32 clear for the cluster)
entries.quality: same clean-pixel rule as NDVI; Landsat dates excluded (no red-edge band)
entries.note: A vegetation signal related to chlorophyll; it does not measure soil nitrogen and is not a fertilization diagnosis.

entries.name: EMIT L2B Fractional Cover v002
entries.question: What was on the ground on a given date: green plants, dry plant material, bare soil?
entries.variables: PV, NPV, BARE fractions (0-1) and uncertainties
entries.dates: 2024-01-08: 32 valid px; 2024-02-23: 32 valid px; 2024-11-11: 32 valid px; 2026-09-15: 32 valid px (2026-09-15 has two scenes; the one with values is used, its twin covered the area with fill only)
entries.scope: cluster of the four examples together; 60 m pixels
entries.quality: NPV can be inflated near cloud and shadow edges; no March-October 2024 scene

entries.name: ECOSTRESS JET v002 / ETAUX v003 / JET v003
entries.question: Historical evapotranspiration and modelled moisture for specific dates
entries.dates: Granules intersecting the study rectangle: JET v002 2024 41; ETAUX v003 2024 0, 2022-2026 70
entries.note: ETAUX soil moisture is downscaled from GEOS-5 FP (model-derived), not a plot measurement. Not read: QA and geolocation of specific scenes were not verified in this version.

entries.name: SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP v008
entries.question: Regional surface and root-zone moisture for comparing periods
entries.note: Too coarse to say anything about a 4 ha irrigated plot; provider notice of a geolocation issue 14 May-28 Jul 2026 under reprocessing.

entries.name: GPM IMERG Final daily
entries.question: Historical rain for comparable dates (complement to POWER)
entries.note: An earlier test (14 Nov 2026) returned HTTP 403; a repeat on 15 Nov 2026 (UTC) returned HTTP 200 from data.gesdisc.earthdata.nasa.gov through a CloudFront redirect (sanitized record in data/raw/imerg_access_test.json). The file was not processed. POWER rain remains the source used in the app.

entries.name: Soil context: ORNL IGBP-DIS (569), HYSOGs250m, SoilGrids
entries.question: Regional soil context
entries.note: Historical or regional surfaces (5 arc-min, 250 m) cannot give current plant-available nitrogen or certify drainage of a field; access and units were not verified. Soil analysis stays a user input with method, depth and date; unknown is valid.

entries.name: ESA WorldCover 2021
entries.question: Screen out tree-covered parcels when choosing the examples
entries.note: Broad land cover, not crop identity; 2021 vs 2024 imagery.

entries.name: Río Negro provincial parcel layer (IDERN WFS geonode:PARCELARIO1)
entries.question: Where are the example parcels and which pixels were sampled?
entries.scope: 2,341 SUBRURAL/RURAL parcels around General Roca; 212 shown on the map; 4 examples sampled
entries.note: Boundaries shown as served, with attribution; no owner or crop. The original GeoJSON is reproduced by download, not redistributed, while redistribution terms are unconfirmed.

entries.name: ERA5-Land
entries.question: Regional cross-check
entries.note: No subset was obtained; models sharing inputs would not be an independent validation.
